# AI storyboard and mockup boards: approve stills before paying for video

**A shot list becomes one HTML board of numbered stills with specs, prompts and approve or fix notes, plus phone and app mockups.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_c2a0028d3c9a.webp" alt="A storyboard approval board titled &quot;Last Bus&quot;: a strip of six night bus-stop frames, the look line and anchors, then frame cards with shot specs and Approve / Needs fix buttons." width="480"></p>

Mock up a video before paying for it: one self-contained HTML board (storyboard board, moodboard, reference board, look test, plan page, contact sheet) with numbered frames, shot specs, prompts, approve / needs-fix / reject and a note per frame, side-by-side variants and feedback copied as Markdown; stills made on varg (Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.5) that do not look like AI slop and stay consistent (character sheets, environment master first, same lens and light); device and app UI mockups (iMessage chat, Apple Notes, iPhone fold, phone stamp carousel, terminals, code editors). Use for "mock up", "mock up a look", "mockup", "storyboard board", "moodboard", "reference board", "look test", "stills for approval", "key frames to approve", "shot board", "phone mockup", "app UI mockup", "screen mockup", or stills that look like AI slop or drift between shots. Not for final video clips (varg-video-prompting) or 3D camera blocking (threejs-animatic).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-mockups                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-mockups --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | HTML review board of stills |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$0.06–0.08 per Nano Banana 2.1 still, ~$0.23 per GPT Image 2.5 high-quality still |
| Uses | varg API, Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.5, HTML, Chrome, Bun, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Mock up my 12-shot ad as a storyboard board with one still per shot before any video is made"
- "Make a look test: the hardest frame in two looks on two image models, side by side with notes"
- "Show me the references and prompts you would use for each shot as a board, but don't generate anything yet"
